construction: Set-in short sleeve with clean athletic armhole
Crew neck with shoulder-to-shoulder internal binding
Four-thread overlock internal seams with coverstitch hems
Side seams permitted; keep print clear of seam allowances
Shorts with 40 mm enclosed elastic waistband and internal matching drawcord
Reinforce drawcord exit and crotch stress points
Remove loose threads; no visible puckering, needle damage, shine, or dye migration
decoration: Use polyester-safe low-cure silicone or dye-blocking screen ink proven on the selected fabric
Minimum printed cell size is 1.4 mm; preserve square corners and original spacing
No gradients, halftones, distress texture, drop shadows, or unapproved trapping
Embroidery must preserve the square-grid geometry without satin-stitch bridging between cells
Return one print strike-off and one embroidery sew-out before pre-production sample
packaging: One complete set per recycled or recyclable protective bag
Apply removable size sticker to outside of bag
Pack by size and provide carton count before shipment
Do not make unsupported recycled, ocean-bound, or certification claims on garment labels

Embroidery thread references and physical sew-out

quality: Colour: approved physical standard under D65 light; no visible panel-to-panel shade variation
Print: full cure, solid coverage, no dye migration, cracking, pinholes, or offset
Embroidery: clean registration, no puckering, loose ends, or backing visible outside artwork
Measurements: within factory-agreed tolerance against approved size chart
Wash: appearance and dimensional stability approved after three care-label wash cycles
Inspection: factory final inspection report and photos before balance payment or shipment
care_proposal: Machine wash cold with like colours, gentle cycle. Do not bleach. Hang dry. Do not iron decoration. Do not dry clean. Factory must validate against selected materials and decoration before label production.
commercial: Target quality band is CAD 30-50 per finished item; quote five prize jerseys and the approximately 20-set community run separately. No bulk authorization follows from this tech pack alone.
